articles.title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
articles.snippet: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.

articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.snippet: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after dip to $76,300 as ETF outflows and midterm elections weigh on crypto
articles.snippet: Bitcoin edged up 0.2% to around $76,900 since midnight UTC as spot ETFs lost $399 million for a second day and Binance customers pulled a net $4.72 billion.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and tech stocks edge higher as U.S. voters head to the polls
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is currently on pace for a fifth straight weekly decline, which would tie for its third-longest losing streak ever.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s latest chart signal looks a lot like the ones before its big crashes
articles.snippet: The Guppy Multiple Moving Average bands signal a bearish momentum, even as seasonality and post-midterm history lean bullish.
